subtitle: Lesson 69 · Azure Automation & Infrastructure as Code

eyebrow: The alert is the actual point
code:
az deployment group create `
  --resource-group myrg `
  --template-file database.bicep `
  --parameters @params.json

if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
  Send-MailMessage -To "dba-team@contoso.com" `
    -Subject "Deployment FAILED" `
    -Body "Check the pipeline log."
  exit 1
}
caption: The deploy is one line. The if-block is what makes it real, unattended automation.
